# Bin Hive

> Bin Hive is an apiary of AI agents for social media content, by Arrobabeto Media (Mexico). It turns a loose idea into ideas, hooks, scripts and captions for Instagram (Reels), TikTok, YouTube Shorts and X, with one specialized "hive" (team of agents) per network. It is currently pre-release; there is a public waitlist.

Key facts:

- 27 specialized agents: 4 network hives × 5 workers (Ideator, Stinger/hooks, Scriptwriter, Quill/captions, Taster/testing) plus 7 shared services (strategy, trends, metrics, build-in-public stories, brand guardian, tech guardian, docs).
- Single entry point (the "Beekeeper"): a request can start from a topic, a one-liner, a draft, a final script or an old piece to recycle.
- Asks at most 4 questions per round, only for missing context. Up to 2 automatic correction rounds.
- 90-day memory to avoid repeating ideas; metrics feed the next request.
- Human in control: the user approves every piece. Bin Hive never publishes to social networks on its own and never makes up product facts.
- For creators/personal brands and for agencies (one profile per client under an agency account, with separate voice, goals and hives).
- Pricing: not announced; plans will be shared with the release.
